verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS fraud-protection product, but nothing in the evidence documents such a control in Radar. The only opt-out mentioned (comm-5) is disabling Radar's per-transaction fraud screening, which is a different control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
